name: @fx-studio-ai/pipeline-orchestrator
description: v8.0.3 (2026-06-17, PATCH — protocol doc guard): adds an explicit anti-pattern note in references/gate-request-protocol.md (parent-side handler) and skills/spec/SKILL.md (Achado #7 handler) — re-dispatch is a fresh Agent() call that re-hydrates state from the run-dir, NOT a live-agent resume; SendMessage is not used by this pipeline and, even where present, is a deferred tool loadable via ToolSearch. Closes the failure mode where the parent main LLM mis-reads an AWAITING_* handshake as needing SendMessage and abandons the run. ZERO runtime change. v8.0.2 (2026-06-16, PATCH — release hygiene): clean npm tarball (drops a leaked runtime session .lock and tracks the previously npm-only /help command; .npmignore hardened for **/.pipeline/ + *.lock; new tests/packaging/no-pack-cruft guard), the Paperclip flow-mirror tests are now wired into the release gate (run-tests.cjs `paperclip` category, 13/13), and the stale description/README prose was refreshed. ZERO runtime change. v8.0.1 (2026-06-15, PATCH — Paperclip layer): reflects the v8.0.0 spec-authoring takeover + fixes the flow-mirror handoff stalls (Montagem Progressiva + structural root-cause guards), additive in references/paperclip, cursor manifest lockstep. v8.0.0 (2026-06-15, MAJOR — spec-authoring takeover): /pipeline-orchestrator:spec now AUTHORS a new specification from scratch (brainstorm clarification + proactive ideation + forced design-interrogation + Kiro lifecycle + adversarial document review + contract seal) and stops before implementing; legacy spec PROCESSING moved to /spec-light, /spec-heavy, /spec-audit-only and /pipeline --type=Spec. Gate Registry 35→43 (8 new AUDIT/SOFT events; the Mandatory Gates by Complexity table is unchanged, F1 preserved). v7.14.1 (2026-06-14, PATCH - gate-decision SSOT shipped / schema-drift fix): entrega a Fase 1 do contract-enforcement ja mergeada em main (commit 4420907) - novo lib/contracts/gate-decision.cjs como fonte unica do vocabulario canonico (8 decisoes + 5 hardness + 13 chaves) consumido por gate-decision-writer + jsonl-sanitizer + fidelity-reporter; encerra o drift que fazia final-validator/pipeline-controller/audit-trail exigirem exatamente 8 chaves e procurarem um RESOLVED nunca emitido. Prosa alinhada ao writer real; novo teste tests/regression/v7.9.0/F-gate-decision-contract (10/10). Auditoria audit-heavy 2026-06-14 confirmou base correta v7.14.0, integracao limpa e zero regressao (suite 114/4/118). Iron Law: quebra minima reconhecida e justificada pelo bug de auto-auditoria. v7.10.1 (2026-06-09, PATCH — parallel_eligible default contract): formaliza o default de parallel_eligible como false quando a analise de sobreposicao nao pode ser concluida. plan-architect ganha Regra 5 exigindo parallel_eligible: false com overlap_reason prefixado 'analysis_incomplete:' quando CHANGE_CONTRACT esta ausente ou contem wildcards. executor-controller ganha guarda explicito tratando parallel_eligible ausente como false com WARN trace, convertendo comportamento implicito JS falsy em contrato observavel. 2 cenarios de regressao adicionados (F22-S10 + F22-S11, total 11). Dogfood validou Plan Mode protocol: 3/3 agentes obrigatorios emitiram PLAN_MODE_REQUEST na primeira tentativa. v7.10.0 (2026-06-07, MINOR — subagent parallel spawning feature): enables subagents within pipeline orchestrators to spawn their own parallel agents without tool restrictions. Adds `subagent_permissions` config block to .claude/settings.json with orchestrator-aware tool access (Agent, Read, Edit, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, PowerShell), max_depth=2, max_parallel_agents=8 safety guardrails. Resolves issue where MiniMax/final-adversarial-orchestrator could not dispatch 3 parallel reviewers (Security, Architecture, Quality) — now runs truly parallel with zero context contamination. applies to all *-orchestrator agents by pattern matching. v7.9.4 (2026-06-06, PATCH — plan-mode contract fix): corrige o contrato do Plan Mode que nunca disparava (21+ runs reais sem nenhum PLAN_MODE_REQUEST; modo de falha B5-001). agents/quality/plan-architect.md: Steps 0/3/4 + rodape Tools + 4 claims de header alinhados ao protocolo Achado #7 — o agente agora emite PLAN_MODE_REQUEST (Step 0) e GATE_REQUEST (Step 3) e PARA, em vez de tentar chamar EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode/AskUserQuestion (ferramentas strippadas de subagentes pelo harness); rodape Tools lista apenas Read/Grep/Glob + blocos de protocolo; label da Rule 1 preservado para o contrato D7-S7 v6.1.0. agents/core/pipeline-controller.md: novo enforcement PLAN_MODE_BYPASS — retorno do plan-architect contendo IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN sem ciclo PLAN_MODE_REQUEST/PLAN_MODE_RESULTS gera evento AUDIT em protocol-events.jsonl + um unico re-dispatch; aceita no segundo bypass (sem deadlock em sessoes legadas); NAO e gate novo (registry de 35 e Inline Invariants intocados). 2 testes novos em tests/regression/v7.9.4/ (F18 plan-mode-contract, 8 cenarios com extractor fence-aware provado por mutacao; F19 controller-inline-plan-check, 6 cenarios) pinam o contrato. Dogfood run completo: Bug Fix/MEDIA/bugfix-light, TDD 14 cenarios RED→GREEN, adversarial per-batch (B1/B2 PASS), final adversarial com 3 revisores zero-context (0 critical; 2 importants corrigidos em rework unico, incl. regressao D7-S7 detectada por verificacao direta e reconciliada), Pa de Cal GO @ 0.94; suite 62/67 = baseline pre-run identico (5 falhas Langfuse/env pre-existentes). Iron Law preservada: references/gates.md, hooks e lib intocados. v7.9.2 (2026-06-02, PATCH - documentation refresh): brings all user-facing and reference docs up to date with features through v7.9.1 — full Paperclip layer documented (integration v7.6.0 + provisioner v7.8.0 + flow-mirror v7.9.0 with 8 paperclip-* commands + new references/paperclip/PAPERCLIP-FLOW-MIRROR.md), audit-trail run-log section aligned to the v7.9.1 model, gate decision vocabulary aligned to the 8 canonical values, count drift fixed (35-gate registry / 23-row mandatory table / 61 tests), and the MIT->PolyForm license fix in the diagrams. Docs-only; Iron Law preserved. v7.9.0 (2026-06-01, MINOR - Paperclip flow-mirror): mirrors the 14 pipeline flows as dependency-linked Paperclip issue trees + 8 paperclip-* slash commands with dry-run/--confirm guard. v7.8.0 (2026-05-26, MINOR - Paperclip company provisioner): ships references/paperclip/scripts/provision-pipeline-company.cjs, an ID-agnostic Node provisioner that stands up a Paperclip company with the full 47-cargo roster + 11 skills (heartbeat OFF), resolving company by name and computing paths from __dirname (no hardcoded UUIDs). Wired into /pipeline-orchestrator:setup-paperclip. v7.7.0 (2026-05-25, MINOR - OpenCode adaptation marketplace release): ships the OpenCode adaptation harness, commands, agents, skills, contract tests, and hardened physical-evidence gates for bugfix, feature, audit, UX, SPEC, final validation, and closeout. Global OpenCode commands now include audit/UX/SPEC light and heavy flows. End-to-end execution governance for Claude Code. Multi-agent pipeline with TDD, adversarial review, 35-gate registry (23 mandatory), glass-box TRACE.md audit trail. v7.6.1 (2026-05-24): release hygiene PATCH — closes doc drift detected during v7.6.0 npm publish (CLAUDE.md canonical line + cursor manifest description + F7 version-sync test). Zero runtime changes. Suite 58/59 GREEN. v7.6.0 (2026-05-22): Paperclip integration layer — references/paperclip/ ships 14 docs + 11 custom skills enabling the plugin to run inside Paperclip (paperclip.ing open-source agent orchestration) via claude_local adapter with effective parity to Claude Code standalone. Includes PAPERCLIP-AXIOMS.md, 6 workflow specs, KB, catalog, adaptation spec, zoning rule, migration plan with adversarial loop, end-to-end pilot report (PARITY_VERDICT=PASS_WITH_NOTES), install-junctions.bat, /setup-paperclip slash command, and docs/PAPERCLIP-INTEGRATION.md. Zero changes to existing agents/skills/references/commands/lib (paperclip/ is additive subdir). v7.5.0 (2026-05-22): concurrent-safe tracing — RunDirectory.allocate uses exclusive mkdir + collision-resistant uniqueId, runId published on PIPELINE_RUN_ID env-var; Langfuse trace/span carriers + sentinel/stop state discovery keyed on PIPELINE_RUN_ID with graceful PPID/mtime fallback + AUDIT breadcrumbs; PIPELINE_TRACING_SCOPE controls Langfuse observation scope (agent-only default = v7.4.0 parity / agent-plus-skill / full). 5 new regression tests (F1-F5). v7.2.0 (2026-05-21): Phase 0 hardening — STATE_FILE_INIT_FAIL gate (CIRCUIT_BREAKER hard precondition on initial sentinel-state.json write), PROTOCOL_HANDSHAKE_TIMEOUT gate (HARD out-of-band timer via SessionStart hook, default 30min configurable), cleanup-orphan-sentinel-state hook (auto-archive of pipeline_active=true state files older than 24h, closes Achado B1-001), --strict-spec flag (rejects Signal 3/4 Spec detection in unattended/CI mode), STRICT_SPEC_REJECTION gate (AUDIT). 4 patches with ATDD/BDD/DDD per batch and adversarial review per batch (22 findings addressed across all batches). v7.1.1 (2026-05-21): docs-only patch. v7.1.0 (2026-05-19): telemetry hygiene.
